text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, how utterly adorable...!
Little doll, I believe I've fallen
in love with you at first sight~...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Blonde hair, morpho butterfly eyes...
Haaah, it's simply enchanting...!

text_block_list.name: Doll Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
She's a lovely one, isn't she?
Actually, just a moment ago, another owner decided to adopt her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, truly. 'Reserved'...
Well, they are such a lovely little one, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, it seems it wasn't meant to be, but I wish you all the happiness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to bring home the doll she fell in love with at first sight,
Mejiro Bright felt a pang of heartache.
